An '''individual''' was employed by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jurga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. To symbolize his power, Jurga wore a [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss]] [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor]] on a sash. At one point, the individual became outraged and used the disruptor to [[Death/Legends|disintegrate]] Jurga, thus killing him.<ref name="AAEG">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The individual in Jurga the Hutt's employ was first mentioned in the [[2002]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'', which was written by [[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]].<ref name="AAEG" />
